# Nilesh Raj - AI/ML Engineer & Forward Deployed Engineer

## Profile
Nilesh Raj is an AI/ML Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer specializing in NLP,
fine-tuning transformer models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and
agentic AI systems. He builds and deploys production-ready AI applications with large
language models. NVIDIA-certified in LLM application development.

## Education
BCA with IBM Specialization (AI & Data Science), United University Prayagraj (2022-2025).

## Core Projects
1. OmniCrew AI: An autonomous multi-agent B2B lead-generation platform built with CrewAI,
   featuring a 3-tier LLM fallback router (DeepSeek -> Mistral -> Gemini) for 99.9% task
   completion, Redis-backed MD5 caching, and JWT multi-tenant data isolation.
   Live: https://omnicrew-ai.vercel.app/ | Code: https://github.com/Nilesh1735/OMNICREW-AI
2. LumanGuide: An enterprise Agentic RAG system on a LangGraph state machine with dynamic
   document grading, query routing, FAISS vector search, prompt-injection guardrails, JWT
   RBAC, and LangSmith LLMOps observability.
   Live: https://lumanguide-app.streamlit.app/ | Code: https://github.com/Nilesh1735/LumanGuide-Onboarding-Illuminated

## Experience
AI/ML Trainee at Technosavvys Education Technology (Remote, Feb-May 2026): Fine-tuned a
BERT text classifier on 500+ reviews (88% accuracy, +15% over baseline) with Hugging Face,
and deployed a real-time Streamlit sentiment dashboard for 10+ mentors.
